The non-negotiables

Must-know foundations

The answers you should have ready at any moment as a biochemistry PhD student — cell architecture, amino acids and pKa values, protein structure, DNA and the central dogma, metabolism in outline. Then the working knowledge: enzyme kinetics, binding and affinity, folding and quality control, the life of a protein, the cloning toolbox, redox and cofactors, and the core methods one card each.
